title: Nutella Banana Bread
style: Soft, moist banana loaf swirled with warm Nutella.
description: A classic banana bread marbled with a hazelnut-chocolate swirl, baked in a 9×5-inch loaf and cut into 10 slices.
steps: Preheat the oven to 175°C / 350°F and spray a 9×5-inch (23×13 cm) loaf tin with nonstick spray.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate large bowl, cream the sugar and softened butter together.
Add the eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Add the mashed bananas, milk, and vanilla, and beat until well combined.
Add the flour mixture and beat on low speed just until the flour is incorporated — do not over-mix.
In a small microwave-safe bowl, heat the Nutella for 15 seconds and stir until smooth. Stir in about 1 cup of the banana bread batter until well mixed.
Spoon the Nutella batter alternately with the plain batter into the prepared tin, then swirl the two together with a knife.
Bake for 50–60 minutes, until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for at least 15 minutes, then turn the loaf out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
tips: Use very ripe, heavily spotted bananas — they mash smoothly and give the loaf its sweetness.
3 medium bananas gives roughly 280 g mashed; weigh rather than counting if yours are large or small.
Warming the Nutella is what lets it swirl instead of clump — don't skip the 15 seconds.
Tent the loaf with foil after 40 minutes if the top is browning too fast.
Keeps well wrapped at room temperature for 3 days, or sliced and frozen for up to 3 months.
